name: Pork Carnitas
recipeIngredient: 1 orange (halved and juiced, rinds tossed in)

recipeInstructions.text: Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch chunks. Season all over with salt, cumin, and dried oregano.
Heat lard in a dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the pork in batches, about 8 minutes per batch.
Return all the pork to the pot. Add orange, white onion, garlic, and bay leaves. Add water.
Cover and braise in a 300°F oven until the pork falls apart, 2 1/2 hours.
Discard the onion, rinds, and bay leaves. Shred the pork with two forks, spread it on a sheet pan, and spoon some of the braising liquid over it.
Broil until the edges are crisp, 5 minutes, then toss and broil 3 minutes more.
Serve in warmed corn tortillas with cilantro, a little more chopped white onion, and limes.
Leftovers: crisp a portion in a hot skillet before serving instead of microwaving it.
